abilities.name: Judgement
abilities.description: Changed. It no longer eats your seal. 10 yd range, 10 sec cooldown. Judging Seal of Fury taunts for 4 sec, so Paladins can tank pulls now.

abilities.name: Seal of Fury
abilities.description: The tank seal. Every hit adds Holy damage, and with a shield up you get an absorb worth half of it.

abilities.name: Holy Strike
abilities.description: Baseline Ret strike on a 12 sec cooldown: weapon damage plus Holy. Several talents build on it.

abilities.name: Blessing of Kings and Consecration
abilities.description: Both trainable now, not talents. Consecration comes at level 20.

abilities.name: Shadow Word: Death
abilities.description: Execute-style Shadow spell. Named by the Early Demise talent.

abilities.name: Devouring Plague
abilities.description: A normal Shadow spell now, not an Undead racial. 1 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Fear Ward
abilities.description: Every Priest gets it. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Aimed Shot
abilities.description: Trainable now instead of a Marksmanship talent, and quicker: 2 sec cast, 6 sec cooldown, shared with Multi-Shot (Classic was a 3 sec cast).

abilities.name: Aspect of the Beast
abilities.description: Changed. Rank 1 makes you untrackable and adds 50 melee attack power. Classic was untrackable only.

abilities.name: Comprehend Scroll
abilities.description: New little ability: decipher an untranslated scroll.

abilities.name: Frostfire Bolt
abilities.description: A bolt that is both Fire and Frost. Four talents mention it.

abilities.name: Subjugate Demon
abilities.description: Enslave Demon, renamed.

abilities.name: Bane of Agony
abilities.description: Curse of Agony, renamed. Bane of Doom the same. Banes and Curses are now separate, so you can run one of each.

abilities.name: Incubus
abilities.description: Male counterpart to the Succubus, its own summon. Named by four Demonology talents.

abilities.name: Victory Rush
abilities.description: Baseline, in the Arms tab. Instant, 30 sec cooldown: a melee hit that heals you for 10% of your maximum health, usable within 20 sec of killing something non-trivial.

abilities.name: Tactical Mastery
abilities.description: A passive in the Arms tab now, not a talent. You keep up to 10 Rage when you change stances on your own, and the Arms talent Improved Tactical Mastery adds up to 15 more.

abilities.name: Intercept
abilities.description: Still in the game: the Fury tree has Improved Intercept.

abilities.name: Slam
abilities.description: Now has a 15 sec cooldown (Classic had none).

abilities.name: Thunder Clap
abilities.description: Changed. Works in Battle or Defensive Stance. Rank 4 slows attacks 20% for 22 sec and hits up to 4 targets, where Classic was 10% for 30.

abilities.name: Bloodrage
abilities.description: Still there, in the Protection tab. 116 health for 10 rage plus 10 more over 10 sec.

abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.description: Changed: 15 min cooldown, 60% less damage for 12 sec (Classic was 30 min, 75% for 10 sec). No longer shares a cooldown with Retaliation and Recklessness.

abilities.name: Shield Block
abilities.description: Changed: 2 charges and 7 sec baseline (Classic was 1 block for 5 sec). Still 10 Rage, 5 sec cooldown, Defensive Stance.

abilities.name: Mutilate
abilities.description: New talent, Assassination row 5. Hits with both weapons for 75% damage each, 20% more on poisoned targets, and gives 2 combo points. Nine other talents feed it.

abilities.name: Venom
abilities.description: New finisher at the bottom of Assassination. Your poisons do 30% more and apply 10% more often, longer per combo point.

abilities.name: Thousand Cuts
abilities.description: New Subtlety capstone. Each Rupture tick takes 3 Energy off your next Hemorrhage or Backstab, stacking to 5.

abilities.name: Axes
abilities.description: Rogues can use one-handed axes now. The Hack and Slash talent lists Axe/Sword as a weapon group.

abilities.name: Omen of Clarity and Nature's Grasp
abilities.description: Both trainable now, not talents. They're in the Balance tab.

abilities.name: Revive
abilities.description: New out-of-combat resurrection, 10 sec cast. Rebirth keeps its 30 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Lacerate
abilities.description: Bear bleed from later expansions, in Forever as a baseline ability: the Shredding Attacks talent cuts its Rage cost.

abilities.name: Cure Poison
abilities.description: Gone. Abolish Poison is the only poison cure.

abilities.name: Lightning Bolt
abilities.description: Half a second faster than Classic. Rank 7 is a 2.5 sec cast.

abilities.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.description: Also half a second faster: rank 1 is a 2 sec cast, 6 sec cooldown, 3 targets, each jump 30% weaker. Max Elemental Alacrity brings Lightning Bolt to the same 2 sec.

abilities.name: Totemic Projection
abilities.description: New. Pick a spot up to 30 yd away and your totems move there, not just to your feet. Totemic Recall is in too.

abilities.name: Call of the Elements
abilities.description: New: drops up to four totems from your Totem Bar in one 3 sec cast.

abilities.name: Fire Nova
abilities.description: A spell now, not a totem: 30 yd range, instant, 10 sec cooldown, and it blasts everything within 10 yd of your active Fire totem. Improved Fire Nova trims 2 sec off the cooldown.
